name: render-recipe
responsibility: The render recipe a picture file carries: read from an SVG's or a PNG's bytes, replaced in place, and recorded into a model render's SVG, so the picture can be drawn again
description: Layer 5, @archboard/render-recipe (TASK-653.16): the renderer's recipe folder and its PNG reader, moved out. Width 4: readRenderRecipe, replaceRenderRecipe, recordArchitectureRecipe and readPngDimensions. embedRecipeInPng is private behind replaceRenderRecipe, and the test-only legacy recipe writer is gone. A recipe's schema composes model-contract's shapes. The CLI's model rasterize and embeds check, the server's flow pictures, raster and the skill grader call it.
